jobDescription:

Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entir... Location Details: India, Remote At Go Daddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​ This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a Go Daddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. Join our team At Go Daddy, the company that empowers entrepreneurs, our Marketing Legal team supports a range of work across growth marketing, outbound communications, performance marketing, advertising, promotions,... organization! The focus of this role will be on supporting international outbound messaging and performance marketing, including messages sent via email, short message service, voice calls, paid media, affiliate, lifecycle, web conversion funnels, advertising experiments, and new territory or new campaign assessments. We want someone with strong legal judgment who approaches risk practically. They should learn quickly, identify patterns, and build scalable solutions. You will know when to raise novel or higher-risk issues. You will assist us in growing legal assistance for fast paced global marketing initiatives. What you'll get to do... Assist Go Daddy’s marketing teams in growing the business by delivering exceptional, risk-calibrated legal support for global campaigns, channels, offers, and customer-facing experiences Support global outbound communications initiatives, including legal review and risk assessment for email, SMS, phone, push notifications, and other customer messaging channels across new and existing markets Help assess legal requirements for launching outbound communications in new territories, including consent, opt-in/opt-out, disclosure, sender identification, frequency, recordkeeping, suppression, and localization requirements Support Go Daddy’s media solutions and ad tech initiatives by providing practical legal guidance on advertising products, audience targeting, measurement, campaign delivery, data use, publisher/advertiser relationships, and related commercial opportunities Serve as a key legal partner to performance marketing teams, including support for paid search, paid social, affiliate, display, lifecycle marketing, landing pages, campaign testing, lead generation, and conversion-focused marketing initiatives Review marketing, advertising, promotional, social media, email, web, and customer-facing materials, including campaign copy, landing pages, creative assets, offer terms, pricing references, comparisons, claims, and disclosures Help support promotions, sponsorships, influencer campaigns, affiliate arrangements, and other marketing initiatives. Draft, review, and help manage marketing-related agreements, including agency, creative services, influencers, sponsorship, affiliate, content licensing, vendor, and statement-of-work documents Coordinate with U.S.-based and global legal team members on critical issues, special projects, and cross-functional initiatives Help develop training materials and practical mentorship for business teams. Assess legal and business risk in marketing initiatives, clearly explain tradeoffs, and recommend practical paths forward Partner with Marketing, Customer Care, Product, Privacy, Commercial Legal, and other collaborators to evaluate new campaigns, customer journeys, and channel strategies in a practical, risk-calibrated way Build scalable playbooks, country mentorship, approval workflows, intake processes, blocking issue paths, templates, trackers, and self-service resources for global marketing and outbound communications Identify recurring legal issues, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvement, then help design durable solutions that allow business teams to move faster with greater consistency and confidence Your experience should include... 6+ years of relevant legal experience, preferably supporting marketing, advertising, consumer communications, commercial contracts, technology, digital products, e-commerce, or other rapidly growing business teams Legal degree or equivalent legal qualification in India; common law, U.S., U.K., or global legal experience is a plus Expertise in assessing risk, helping business teams make informed decisions, and building systems, playbooks, and processes that enable business growth We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth. We've got your back...
